# Astronomy Engine

Vendored official ES module, version 2.1.19, downloaded 2026-10-08.
Source: https://github.com/cosinekitty/astronomy/blob/master/source/js/esm/astronomy.js
Author: Don Cross. License: MIT (astronomy-LICENSE.txt).
Used for the seven non-Earth planets via Equator(ofdate=true, aberration=true) and Horizon.
No network request or package installation is required at runtime.
